set.body:
Follow-up split from P6f.33 after the behaviour was settled from documentation and independent reports rather than a site capture.

Capture exact stdout/stderr/exit code with provenance for:
- squeue --json=v0.0.43 --jobs=<terminal job>
- squeue --json=v0.0.43 --jobs=<queued>,<terminal> (does squeue still emit JSON for the surviving job, or refuse the whole query?)

The scheduler currently keeps whatever the response described and marks the rest NotFound, which is correct under either behaviour, but the mixed case is untested against a real controller.
set.title: P6f.33a: Capture live squeue absence transcript for a departed job
